objective: Forensically extract the portable layout-capacity, anti-collapse, visual QA, self-refinement, and composition-routing ideas from Mck-ppt-design-skill for Stage 4 of ppt-hybrid-lab. We already rejected its flat high-level component API as our product architecture; this task focuses narrowly on constraints and gates that can make a Visual-IR-driven hybrid system more robust without reducing design to generic component templates.
questions: What machine-readable layout capacity constraints exist (max items, title/body char budgets, special limits), where are they enforced, and which are data-driven versus hard-coded?
How are layouts selected in Stage 2 and how much of that is semantic/rhetorical routing versus page-type/component selection?
What concrete anti-collapse rules exist for overflow, spacing, dynamic sizing, peer consistency, title uniformity, chart legends, horizontal item limits, or text fitting? Cite exact files/functions.
How do S3 and S4 gates derive pass/fail results? Identify which checks are objective, which are proxy metrics, and which can falsely pass an ugly slide.
What is stored in experiences/ and how does the self-refinement loop turn one-off failures into reusable rules? Which pattern is suitable for our Stage 4 visual system?
What layout-specific implementation notes in references/layouts are actually portable as archetype constraints rather than renderer recipes?
Which quality checks should become Visual IR compiler validations before rendering, which should be PPTX structural QA after rendering, and which require pixel/multimodal review?
What should ppt-hybrid-lab explicitly reject from MCK because it encourages card soup, rigid page templates, positional identity, or geometry-only QA?
Propose a clean-room capacity/guardrail schema for our composition archetype registry and a machine-recorded Stage 4 visual gate.
Recommend how to prevent the specific Stage 3 failure mode: technically valid equal-weight layouts with weak focal hierarchy and dead space.
Name exact follow-up paths/symbols if the bounded context is insufficient.
expected_output: Executive summary of portable constraint/gating ideas
RECOMMENDATION section for Stage 4 Visual IR/archetype/compiler/QA
Proposed clean-room capacity and gate schema fragments
Open questions / exact follow-up source needs
